inspiration: Tiered armour names: each armour family appears in six tier variants with tier words in the name, so a tier reads at a glance (public/static/items.json, see the first armour entries near line 19033). Recreate the six-tier ladder with our own tier words, a colour ramp and a silhouette step, not the donor's names.

Water as two maps: a small normal map (water_n) and an environment map (water_e) are loaded together for a surface (src/components/builder/export-dialog.jsx lines 235-240). Recreate with two procedural maps: a wave-line normal and a zone-tinted reflection. The water_n file is only 2 KB, so the detail is simple.

Cheap sky: a six-face JPG cube sky with small faces, where the top face is the smallest (public/static/skybox_*.jpg, about 84 KB in total). Recreate with a horizon band and a time-of-day tint, not a detailed cube.

Zone as one row: each zone is a record with a short id, a numeric id, a map file and a safe point (public/static/zoneData.json, safe_x and safe_y on each record). Keep a safe point on every zone row; add a walk-density field so a zone can say what appears every 20 seconds of walking.

Named sprite atlas with four-state tiles: atlas.json maps names to a sheet rectangle, and achievement tiles come in locked, unlocked, hover and selected states (public/static/eqassets/atlas.json, Achievement_* images). Keep the four states; change the locked state to show a shape cue, not only grey.
Animated class icons: a looping gif per class for the portrait corner (public/static/eqassets/animated, 15 gif). Recreate as a short looping sprite, not a gif.

One figure file, several figures: a single GLB holds the class figures and the exporter places them at offsets for a lineup (src/components/exporter/constants.js lines 6-11). Keep the single-file lineup for previews; change proportions so each class has its own silhouette.

briefs.label: Six-tier armour ladder
briefs.why: Tier must read at a glance at 375 wide. A fixed ladder of six tiers per armour family does that without a second icon.
briefs.keep: six tiers per armour family; the same family name on every tier; tier shows as a fixed word step
briefs.change: tiers shown by colour ramp and trim count, not name words; silhouette step (shoulder or skirt) at the top tiers; our own tier words

briefs.label: Two-map water sheet
briefs.why: A wave normal and a reflection map read as water without extra geometry.
briefs.keep: a normal map and an environment map loaded as one pair for a surface
briefs.change: wave lines instead of ripples; reflection tinted by the zone colour; scroll speed set per zone

briefs.label: Hub sky cube
briefs.why: A cheap six-face sky with a horizon band gives a hub zone a sense of place.
briefs.keep: six small faces; the horizon band carries the detail
briefs.change: fixed sun glyph and a time-of-day tint; no skyline silhouette

briefs.label: Preview lineup
briefs.why: Every class figure in one file, placed at offsets, gives a quick comparison for a class select screen.
briefs.keep: one model file with several figures placed at offsets
briefs.change: each figure has a distinct silhouette and proportion; a plinth per figure instead of a flat stage
